title.official: Seoul Declaration for safe, innovative and inclusive AI

issuer.name: Participants in the AI Seoul Summit (Republic of Korea and United Kingdom hosts)

relevance.reason: Leaders' declaration from the AI Seoul Summit, continuing the Bletchley process with commitments to safe, innovative and inclusive AI and international cooperation. It is a political declaration, not a treaty.
ai_provisions: Whole declaration — safe, innovative and inclusive AI; international cooperation; follow-up to Bletchley
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding; no legal obligations or enforcement.

dates.notes: Adopted at the Leaders' Session of the AI Seoul Summit on 21 May 2024.

status_note: Adopted by Australia, Canada, the European Union, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Republic of Korea, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States.

sources.note: Official text and list of participating leaders.
Official announcement of the Seoul Declaration and the AI Safety Institute network.
